mergeRule: Apply topLevelPatch, replace entries by exact id, append new entries by unique id, append evidence files by unique path, then apply licenseAuditPatch. Refresh every referenced path hash from final source after integration. Do not infer completion from this fragment.

topLevelPatch.scope: v12 concise left-side dialogue and step guidance, finite shoe/sock removal, licensed mesh anatomy posters, five contiguous pressure plates and original synthetic static/walking/maximum pressure/COP teaching. Complete-site 13-experiment navigation retained.

entriesReplaceById.source: Original pressure-engine.js equal-area sole cells, non-negative synthetic contact weights, force-weighted COP, static sway and asynchronous peak image. pressure-stage.js paints the same frame on scene plates; original case-flow.js and learning-ui.js present task logic.

entriesReplaceById.dataStatus: Original synthetic relative-load teaching data; no patient, sensor, device-calibrated pressure, or sampled full-body COM. Separate retained public research samples are explicitly independent.
limits: No clinical kPa, N, sensor calibration or patient measurements
Current COP is weighted by current synthetic non-negative contact loads; zero load and swing yield null COP
Walking feet share one authored gait clock; standing foot anchors remain fixed
The per-cell maximum image combines peaks from different times and has no instantaneous total force or COP
COP is not full-body COM or the actor pelvis reference point
Low-arch contact illustration is not flatfoot diagnosis or evidence of a sole CAI cause
Static, dynamic and maximum modes keep fixed relative colour scale and condition labels
